description: This file defines the interface ShoppingCartCalculationService, which declares methods for calculating the total prices, subtotals, and line item prices of a ShoppingCart object in an e-commerce system. It specifies method signatures but contains no implementation.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods to calculate total, subtotal, and line item prices for ShoppingCart objects.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total, subtotal, and line item prices for a shopping cart including the customer, store, and language context.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates total, subtotal, and line item prices for a shopping cart in the context of a store and language, without customer details.
